The extended view contains the response shown below.
The normal view contains 'current_revision_id' instead of an embedded object 'current_revision'

parameters.description: Filter item(s) with or without revisions.

parameters.description: Filter item(s) with the matching search query. The search is performed on title.

parameters.description: Sort item(s) by an attribute. The default sort is ascending. To sort in descending order, prepend the sort value with a hyphen character '-'

import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/bim_models?project_id=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&per_page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&view=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filters%5Bid%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Bbim_file_id%5D=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&filters%5Bhas_revisions%5D=SOME_BOOLEAN_VALUE&filters%5Bsearch%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE&sort=SOME_STRING_VALUE")

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"project_id\":126,\"view\":\"compact\",\"bim_model\":{\"title\":\"Combined Model\",\"auto_publish\":false}}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("POST", "/rest/v1.0/bim_models", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

  --data '{"project_id":126,"view":"compact","bim_model":{"title":"Combined Model","auto_publish":false}}'
